description: This file defines the ACL class used for access control within the Goteo project. It manages resource-to-role mappings and provides a method to check if a user has access to a specific URL based on their roles.

classes.name: ACL
classes.description: Provides methods for resource-based access control, checking user permissions based on URL prefixes and user roles.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks whether the given user has permission to access the specified URL based on predefined resource-role mappings.
